title: Hanasato Minori — I'll Treasure It For Life!〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Courtyard

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: And if I do end up switching to the credit-based course, I promise to still message you guys. Every single day...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: No, every single hour!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, that seems like a bit much.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Whaaat?!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, I know. Minori, Shiho, are you both free after school today?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wait, today?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah, I'm free! We're taking a break from practice!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I have work later tonight, but I'm free until then.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Really? Then, how about we all go to the arcade together for a little bit?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: One of my teammates told me they just got a new Print Sticker machine in that's supposed to be pretty fun, so I've been wanting to go.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, that's perfect! We can commemorate this moment by taking some pictures together!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I don't mind, but what exactly are we commemorating?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, um... Me telling you both I'll be switching over to the credit-based course!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I could've guessed as much.

rows.Speaker: Minori & Kohane
rows.Line:
Haha!
Hehe.
Arcade

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, I think it's this one.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: “Decorate your photos in a variety of fun ways, including doodling, placing stamps and other unique features!”

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Interesting. Well, it's open, so shall we?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Still, it doesn't seem all that different from the other machines...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hey, look! This lets you doodle for a really long time!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: It did say that you can edit and doodle in a variety of ways. I guess they really want us to have fun with that.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah! So, everyone, grab a pen!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Okay, okay...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. I think I'll try adding a bunch of these stamps.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Then, I'll use the makeup function to turn us all into supermodels!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, this lets you give your skin a fairer complexion. It's nice how you can do that even after you've taken your photo.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah, you're right! Then, I'll max this out, put a lot of blush on our cheeks, make our eyes really big and...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Wait, Minori, stop!
We look like something kindergartners finger paint. Let's start over.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wait, but! Print Stickers are all about going a little overboard with these effects! It makes these pictures more memorable!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Yeah, I agree...
As in, they might show up in my nightmares.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Exactly!
We've gotta make sure they're unforgettable!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Did you miss the part where I mentioned nightmares?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe... Oh, Shiho, Minori, what do you think about these star stamps?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, these heart ones are also really cute. Mind if I try placing some?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Why not? Knock yourself out.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: You really do have an eye for this stuff, Kohane!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Shiho, you should try something too.
We still have so many more functions to test out.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Too many in my opinion...
Let's see... Different effects, stamps, text and... Hm?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Funny faces...?
What does this do...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: *Giggle*

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Shiho, is something wrong?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Hehe. G-Get ready...
Look.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Huh...? Whaaat?!
I-Is that me?! With a cleft chin?!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: H-Hehe...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
I can even give you an underbite.
Check it out.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Nooo! My jaaawww!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Sh-Sh-Sh-Shiho, how could you?! My jaw! I'm an idol!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Didn't you just say that it's better to go a little overboard? Oh, but I think I liked the cleft chin better.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Then, I'm gonna give you some big googly eyes and a huge underbite!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Hey, don't make them that big!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Okay, you two, no fighting.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wait a second... Kohane, you still look completely normal!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, you're gonna stick out like a sore thumb if we don't make you look like us.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: W-Wait, I...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I'll do her makeup!
Shiho, you edit her jaw!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Okay, we can give her a cleft chin, an underbite or...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
P-Please, you two!
We won't even be able to recognize ourselves!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
I-If you don't stop...
I'll give you both some big, puckered lips!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Wait, you can do that?!
Lemme see! Lemme see!
